description: Retrieve a list of comments for a specific post from the esa team. Requires a post number and supports pagination. Returns comment metadata including content, author information, timestamps, and engagement metrics (stars).

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts from 1.

per_page.description: Number of comments per page. Range: 1-100, default is 20.

post_number.description: Post number to get comments for (required).

name: get_post_comments
